name: AIWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The league's own top singles belt, billed on "Crazy" Joe Davola throughout this record's own held documents.

name: AIWL United States Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles belt whose reigning champion vanished mid-defense under mysterious circumstances on the league's own 3 August 1999 broadcast, with no confirmed title change.

name: AIWL Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: A secondary singles belt, billed on Ash entering the league's own 21 August pay-per-view.

name: AIWL Platinum Championship
epitaph: A contested singles belt whose 3 August 1999 defense ended when the match's own senior official stopped it and declared himself champion, an outcome the league's own broadcast team called unconfirmed on air.

name: AIWL Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The league's own tag championship, referenced only in passing in this record's own held documents.
